preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 5 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range.
The number of test cases t is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for u, v, x, y in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case contains four distinct cities within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(time) <= 2 * 10**5 or int(time) == -1 for time in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output is either a non-negative integer (time) or -1 (infinite time).

postconditions.expression: all(time == 0 or (time != -1 and time == min_time_to_meet(u, v, x, y, tree)) for time, (u, v, x, y) in zip(outputs, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 0 if they start at the same city, otherwise it is the minimum time they meet at the same city, or -1 if they never meet.
